name: neuro
title: Neuroscience
summary: Spiking-network and single-neuron simulation (Brian2, NEURON), EEG and MEG analysis (MNE), brain-image analysis (nilearn, nibabel), spike-train statistics (Neo, Elephant). No recordings or atlases are included.

tools.name: brian2
tools.does: simulator for spiking neural networks, with models written as equations
tools.check: python -c "from brian2 import *; prefs.codegen.target='numpy'; G=NeuronGroup(1,'dv/dt=(1.1-v)/(10*ms):1',threshold='v>1',reset='v=0',method='exact'); M=SpikeMonitor(G); run(100*ms); print('spikes', M.num_spikes)" 2>/dev/null

tools.name: neuron
tools.does: the NEURON simulator: detailed models of single neurons and networks, with cable equations and ion channels
tools.check: python -c "from neuron import h; s=h.Section(name='soma'); s.insert('hh'); print('sections', len(list(h.allsec())))"

tools.name: mne
tools.does: EEG and MEG analysis: filtering, epochs, source estimates, statistics
tools.check: python -c "import mne, numpy as np; r=mne.io.RawArray(np.zeros((2,200)), mne.create_info(['a','b'],100.,'eeg'), verbose=False); print('last', r.times[-1])"

tools.name: nilearn, nibabel
tools.does: brain-image files (nibabel) and statistics and machine learning on them (nilearn)
tools.check: python -c "import nibabel, nilearn, numpy as np; print('shape', nibabel.Nifti1Image(np.zeros((4,4,4)),np.eye(4)).shape)"

tools.name: neo, elephant
tools.does: spike trains and other electrophysiology data (Neo) and their statistics: rates, correlations, synchrony (Elephant)
tools.check: python -c "import neo, quantities as pq; from elephant.statistics import mean_firing_rate; print('rate', mean_firing_rate(neo.SpikeTrain([1,2,3]*pq.s, t_stop=10*pq.s)))"
